architecture_brief_approval_phrase: I approve this Architecture Brief for rendering.

answers.answer: Authorize payment synchronously through an external payment provider before writing the order; do not create the order when authorization fails.
Send terminal delivery or processing failures to one SQS dead-letter queue, with no automatic redrive.
Only authenticated customers may upload; protect POST /uploads with a JWT authorizer backed by an external OIDC identity provider.
Keep Grafana private and expose it through an internal ingress reachable only over the corporate VPN.
Retain Prometheus metrics for 15 days on a persistent volume and retain Tempo traces and Loki logs for 30 days in shared S3-compatible object storage.
Require one human approval after packaging and before the production deploy stage.
The deployment controller rolls back to the previous image when /healthz fails continuously for five minutes.
Use CI-provider-hosted runners outside the production trust boundary.
Use one external managed model API for both embeddings and generation, outside the application trust boundary.
An operator manually starts indexing after placing a reviewed document set in the imports directory.
Authenticate query API users with JWTs issued by an external OIDC identity provider.
The processor's hosted fields tokenize card data in the browser; raw card details never enter our systems.
The payment adapter owns payment state transitions; the order stores only the processor reference and a projected status.
The adapter verifies processor signatures, places accepted webhooks on a durable queue with exponential retries, and deduplicates by processor event ID.
Use BGP only: advertise office prefix 192.168.0.0/16 to the cloud and cloud prefix 10.40.0.0/16 to the office, with no static routes.
One office gateway and the one logical VPN are sufficient for this diagram; do not add customer-side failover.
Use conditional forwarding between office DNS and a cloud private DNS resolver.
The office firewall controls office egress, and cloud security groups control access inside the VPC; do not add an inline cloud firewall appliance.
Authenticate each device with a unique X.509 certificate provisioned by a device registry, and enforce revocation at the broker.
Use MQTT QoS 1 and at-least-once delivery; consumers deduplicate using the device message ID.
A factory gateway buffers up to 24 hours of telemetry while disconnected and forwards it after reconnection.
Retain raw stream data for 7 days and normalized readings for 13 months, with no archive tier.
The commerce monolith remains the sole owner of catalog writes in the current-state diagram.
Keep the shared commerce database for the phase shown; a dedicated catalog database is outside this phase.
No synchronization mechanism is needed in this phase because write ownership and the shared database do not change.
Rollback sends catalog reads back to the monolith at the gateway; the shared database remains unchanged.
US is the authoritative write region; the EU application serves reads only.
Use asynchronous logical replication from the US database to the EU database.
Route 53 checks each regional /healthz endpoint, removes an unhealthy region, and targets a 10-minute RTO and 5-minute RPO.
No regional session affinity is required; application sessions are stateless and represented by signed client tokens.
Stream product database changes with CDC and ingest SaaS records in one nightly batch.
Product dashboards need data within 15 minutes, SaaS dashboards by 08:00 daily, and ML experiment datasets once per day.
A single managed workflow orchestrator inside the data-platform boundary owns ingestion and transformation dependencies.
Classify and mask sensitive fields in the ingestion layer before object storage, then enforce central access policies on trusted datasets.
The platform supports offline ML experiments only; online model serving is out of scope.
